description: Convx 1.5.3 (Beta) introduces a reimagined Wrapped experience with interactive story cards, an adaptive editorial redesign for lyrics sharing, a refined tablet navigation architecture, and extensive performance enhancements across the entire audio pipeline.

changelog.title: Editorial Lyrics Sharing
items: Brand-new adaptive typography engine that dynamically balances single-line punchlines and multi-stanza quotes.
Refined visual hierarchy featuring responsive album artwork scaling, subtle watermark typography, and frosted glass branding pills.
High-fidelity image export engine optimized for social sharing with zero layout distortion.

changelog.title: Wrapped Stories Experience
items: Instagram and Spotify-style segmented story progress bars with auto-advancing visual chapters.
Interactive tap navigation: tap the right edge to advance, left edge to rewind, or touch and hold to pause.
Seamless YouTube Music account integration badge confirming your connected streaming identity.
Smart all-time playback fallback ensures your Wrapped renders rich insights even when recent history is limited.
Completely refreshed visuals for Top Songs, Top Artists, and final Year-in-Review recap summaries.

changelog.title: Adaptive Tablet & Large Screen Ergonomics
items: Floating navigation sidebar upgraded with physics-based spring transitions and staggered label choreography.
Landscape and tablet lyrics experience now includes full access to the track action menu.
Responsive hero layouts across Artist and Album pages eliminate component overlap on wide screens.

changelog.title: Library, Search & Visual Polish
items: Resolved Search screen category pill touch interception for instant, effortless filtering.
Restored and expanded full support for Cached and Uploaded playlists in your Library.
Eliminated color flashing on page transitions with seamless dynamic hero background crossfading.
Dynamic contextual contrast for lyric provider attributions in light and dark themes.
